paras: It’s good to give this more time once or twice a week, when that’s useful. It doesn’t have to be very intense but it is good to start from Higher Self or at least a neutral witnessing place and follow what appears. It’s also good to bring in some adult function to make sure nothing is being bypassed and so that at the end of the exercise, when the experience is over, there is the possibility of coming out completely and doing whatever normal thing needs doing.
